text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar or fast food. Second, exercise regularly—even a 30-minute walk each day can help. Third, get enough sleep, about seven to eight hours, so you feel fresh. Mental health is also important; talk to friends or family when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Don’t work all the time. Make time for hobbies and rest. These simple habits can make you healthier and happier.
